$Comment: Being on the server while a calendar event runs, counted once per player per run. Target is the calendar event id (its file name under Server/ZiggfreedCommon/CalendarEvents); Qualifier is the year the run began in, as four digits, so a step naming a Qualifier counts only that year's run and a step without one counts any run. Amount counts runs, so Amount 3 means three different years. A step reads {"Kind": "CALENDAR_ATTENDED", "Target": "Spring_Fair", "Amount": 1}.
